Q5217.reason: The catalog is an invitation, the PO is the offer, and Costco's expressly conditional acceptance is a counteroffer that Rainmaking never accepted, so no contract exists.

Q6156.reason: Under FRE 804(b)(1), the company had both the opportunity and a similar motive to cross-examine the engineer at the deposition, so it qualifies as former testimony.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani v. UK (2001) the ECtHR held 9-8 that state immunity did not violate Article 6 right of access to court.
